title: Split StyleControls into deep module hierarchy
description: Refactor StyleControls.php into domain, subdomain, and block modules without changing Elementor control IDs or behavior.
objective: Turn StyleControls.php into a small orchestrator and move shared/type-specific controls into bounded files that can safely receive future polish.
expected_outputs: StyleControls.php facade under the orchestrator line budget
Range and Rating split below subdomain level where needed
acceptance_criteria: No Elementor control ID is renamed.
No new visual behavior is added during extraction.
Each authored module stays inside DEC-EIT-014 line budgets or opens a split follow-up.
Style cadence still sees all required control classes.
verification: Agentic Ops validate_task and validate_subplan pass.
PHP lint passes for plugin PHP files.
line-budget guard passes or reports only approved transition exceptions.

budgets.validation_budget: lint, composer, WP-CLI, line-budget, diff checks

risks: Moving registration code can accidentally alter section/control order.
Control ID drift would break existing widgets.
Splitting too shallowly recreates the monolith under new filenames.
